Technical SEO.title: Google Admits Search Console Reporting For AI Search Is Inadequate
Technical SEO.summary: Google has acknowledged that Search Console's current AI search reporting does not adequately reflect AI search positioning data for SEO practitioners. This is a direct admission that enterprise SEOs currently lack reliable tooling to measure AI search visibility through Google's own platform.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Matt Mullenweg Apparently Back In Charge At Automattic
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Automattic has announced that Matt Mullenweg has returned with full board support, though the official announcement has raised additional questions about the circumstances of his return. This has potential implications for the WordPress and web publishing ecosystem that many enterprise SEO content operations depend on.

AI Search / GEO.title: LLM Citation Study: 13,184 Citations Across 4 AI Tools
AI Search / GEO.summary: Orbit Media Studios published a data study analyzing citation patterns across four AI tools, covering a sample of over 13,000 citations to identify which source types and domains earn the most AI references. This is directly actionable for enterprise GEO strategy focused on earning citations in AI-generated answers.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT Search visibility now depends on web.run and fan-out queries
AI Search / GEO.summary: This piece examines how ChatGPT search visibility is shaped by the web.run tool and fan-out query behavior, offering a technical lens on how the model retrieves and surfaces content. Understanding these retrieval mechanics is essential for brands optimizing for AI answer inclusion.

AI Search / GEO.title: Mastering generative engine optimization in 2026: Full guide
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land published a comprehensive guide to generative engine optimization covering strategies for improving brand visibility in AI-generated search results in 2026. As a full guide from a major industry publication, it serves as a reference framework for enterprise GEO program-building.

AI Search / GEO.title: Zeta Announces Generative Engine Optimization Solution to Help Brands Lead in the Post-Search Era
AI Search / GEO.summary: Zeta Global has announced a dedicated GEO product aimed at helping brands maintain visibility as AI-driven search displaces traditional results pages. The launch signals growing enterprise martech investment in AI search visibility tooling, relevant for teams evaluating vendor options.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top Cited Domains Across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: LLM Pulse has published a data study identifying the domains most frequently cited across major AI platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overview surfaces. Benchmarking which domains earn citations across multiple AI engines is directly useful for enterprise GEO competitive analysis.

AI Search / GEO.title: What Actually Gets You Cited in AI Search (2026 Data)
AI Search / GEO.summary: Digital Applied published a data-driven study identifying the factors that correlate with citation inclusion in AI search responses in 2026. The research angle makes this more actionable than generic GEO listicles for teams building evidence-based content strategies targeting AI answer surfaces.
